CATEGORY: 量词选择 (Grammar)
definition: Use the appropriate measure word for the noun, including polite 位 and noun-specific classifiers such as 棵.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (3 distinct):
1 | 这/那 + Measure word + noun.
1 | 本+N. is usually used in formal advertisement/news, also it indicates the author owns the tree, which is not the fact: the author is a pear, who does not own the whole pear tree. 爬上这棵树。
1 | “位” is a polite MW.

HER CORRECTIONS (11 of 11):
[pear_story#4/f38/p0/k0/e0] 这[+个]奇怪的男孩一看到她  || her note: 这/那 + Measure word + noun.
[pear_story#4/f3/p0/note/e0] 他这个没有礼貌的人每天爬上⟦本树⟧  || her note: 本+N. is usually used in formal advertisement/news, also it indicates the author owns the tree, which is not the fact: the author is a pear, who does not own the whole pear tree. 爬上这棵树。
[mengmu_samples#1/f0/p0/k0/e0] 有[一位小孩子叫孟子→一个叫孟子的小孩子]  || her note: “位” is a polite MW.
[pear_story#4/f11/p0/k0/e0] 先打了[+个]大哈欠
[shennong_samples#39/f3/p0/k0/e0] 有[一位人→一个人]来了
[shennong_samples#41/f6/p0/k0-1/e0] [过几个分钟→过了几分钟]
[shennong_samples#13/f3/p0/k0-1-2/e1] 他正好吃[一毒→一种有毒]的花
[pear_story#2/f0/p1/k0/e0] 一个农人爬着[一个树→一棵树]
[shennong_samples#50/f9/p0/k0/e1] 有一天神农走过去[+一个]漂亮的地方的时候
[pear_story#4/f39/p0/k0/e0] 我们[梨堆一族→这堆梨]都乱地滚来滚去地上
[shennong_samples#47/f5/p0/k0-1/e0] 老板第一次看到[一黄色新的花→一种新的黄色的花]

output.rule: Use the appropriate measure word before the noun: 这/那 + Measure word + noun. Use noun-specific measure words such as 棵 for trees, and 位 is a polite MW.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: use <measure word> with <noun>; <brief reason, such as “位” is polite or 棵 is for trees>.

examples.explanation: 这奇怪的男孩 → 这个奇怪的男孩: 这/那 + Measure word + noun.
本树 → 这棵树: use 棵 for a tree; 本+N. is usually formal advertisement/news language and can indicate ownership.
一位小孩子 → 一个叫孟子的小孩子: 位 is a polite MW.
一个树 → 一棵树: use 棵 for a tree.

output.not_an_error: Do not use 位 for a child in this context; 位 is a polite MW. 本+N. is usually used in formal advertisement/news and may indicate that the author owns the noun.
